integrity: The manuscript supplies the dated eligible base families and category triples. The complete finite enumeration from the thirteen Hasse covers verifies the special base homotopy-component premise: 12,575 selfmaps, with components 12,573/1/1. An independently regenerated 11-point cap gives 232,727 selfmaps and five components. The universal monoid classification is proved structurally for every positive integer in the stated range. Closely related published record abstracts were compared; full linked repository texts were unavailable, and that limitation is disclosed in the originality review.
scientific_limitations: Only unbased homotopy classes of order-preserving selfmaps are classified, not the homotopy type of the entire mapping space. The exact nine-point computation is exhaustive for that finite base; the all-m statement follows from a separate symbolic cap lemma. The spaces are not weakly equivalent.
title: Identical self-homotopy monoids across a weak-category gap in finite spaces
